messages:
kevin: Quick Q — I need to add my stepdaughter to benefits. She's a UK national, lives with us part-time, and has an ITIN application receipt (no SSN yet). What docs do you need and how will payroll deductions be handled? Also, will she be eligible for HSA/FSA reimbursements?

michelle-peopleops: Congrats! Sounds like a QLE (stepchild via marriage). We'll need the QLE evidence + dependent docs. For foreign nationals with an ITIN, we accept: passport (photo page), custody/guardianship letter or marriage certificate showing relationship, and either the ITIN or the ITIN application receipt. If you have translations, use certified translations. Upload within 30 days of the QLE to avoid missing the enrollment window.

kevin: Got it. It's stepchild via my recent marriage — I have the marriage cert and a custody letter. I only have the ITIN application receipt right now.

michelle-peopleops: Perfect. Steps: 1) Go to Benefits > Add Dependent and start a QLE enrollment. 2) Upload docs: marriage_cert.pdf, custody_letter.pdf, passport.pdf, ITIN_receipt.pdf. Accepted formats: PDF/JPEG, max 10MB each. If any doc needs translation, include certified translation. Portal link: https://redwood.example.com/benefits/upload

benefits-bot: Document received: kev_stepchild_passport.pdf (status: Needs verification). ETA verification: 2 business days. :white_check_mark:

maria-payroll: Heads up on payroll side — deductions begin the first full pay period after the enrollment effective date. If coverage becomes effective mid-pay-period we prorate the deduction. Proration formula we use: (days of coverage in pay period / total days in pay period) * monthly premium. Once benefits team confirms effective date we'll post the deduction estimate and payroll will apply it on the next payroll cycle.

kevin: Do I need to submit a new W-4 or anything for tax withholding because she's on an ITIN? Any other tax implications?

michelle-peopleops: Good Q. Updating W-4 is optional and only needed if you want to change claimed dependents for withholding; if you plan to claim her as a dependent on your taxes, update the W-4 and consult a tax advisor about ITIN timing. Payroll won’t change withholding automatically without an updated W-4. Submit W-4 updates here: https://payroll.example.com/w4. Note: an ITIN is acceptable for tax purposes once issued; until then, you may have temporary limitations when filing — check with a tax pro.

michelle-peopleops: On HSA/FSA: HSA eligibility depends on your medical plan (must be HDHP). Adding a dependent doesn't disqualify you from contributing unless the dependent has coverage that itself disqualifies HDHP status. FSAs reimburse for eligible dependent expenses regardless of dependent citizenship, so that should be fine.

jenny-manager: FYI I reviewed and approved the QLE attestation on my end. If you need a manager note for the benefits team, LMK.

kevin: Uploading the docs now. Anything else I should expect after upload?

benefits-bot: Upload received: custody_letter.pdf, marriage_cert.pdf. Status: Pending verification. Next: benefits verification -> payroll proration estimate -> enrollment confirmation notification.

michelle-peopleops: Once verification is complete we'll send you a confirmation message with the coverage effective date and the exact deduction amount (prorated if applicable). If the ITIN is still pending at the 60-day checkpoint we'll mark the enrollment as provisional; final enrollment requires a tax identifier within 60 days to avoid retroactive adjustments.

kevin: Thanks — will watch for the confirmation and ping if any docs are flagged. Much appreciated! :pray:
